title: Developments In India And In The World Gravitational Waves
definition: Gravitational waves are ripples in the fabric of spacetime caused by massive accelerating cosmic objects (such as colliding black holes or neutron stars), predicted by Albert Einstein in 1916 and directly detected for the first time in 2015.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Exam (Prelims: Physics, astronomy missions, international scientific collaborations; Mains GS Paper 3: Science & Technology - awareness in the fields of space technology, IT, computers, robotics, nanotechnology, bio-technology and issues relating to intellectual property rights).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Developments In India And In The World Gravitational Waves.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: General Science (Physics - Einstein's General Theory of Relativity)
